map.基于浏览器 Web Speech API，将文字朗读为语音，支持中英文、语速音调: Reads text aloud via the browser Web Speech API, supporting Chinese and English with adjustable rate and pitch
map.视障辅助阅读：粘贴长文，选中文语音（zh），点击朗读，浏览器本地合成语音逐字播报: Reading assistance for the visually impaired: paste a long text, select a Chinese voice (zh), and click read; the browser synthesizes the speech locally and reads it character by character, which combined with screen reader software gives accessible reading, and the text is never uploaded to the server.
map.中英文切换：语言筛选切到英文，选择 en 语音，朗读 “Hello, how a: Chinese / English switching: switch the language filter to English, choose an en voice, and read "Hello, how are you today?"; rate and pitch are adjustable (0.5~2.0) to suit different listening preferences.
map.公共语音提示：用预制“请注意安全，慢行通过。”等提示语，调音量/语速生成候车厅、: Public voice announcements: use preset announcements such as "Please watch your step and proceed slowly.", adjust the volume / rate to produce waiting-hall and corridor broadcast scripts, and play them on a loop or export them.
map.默认文本“欢迎使用语音合成工具，在这里输入文字即可朗读。”（含标点共 23 字）: The default text "Welcome to the speech synthesis tool; type here and it will be read aloud." (23 characters including punctuation), with a Chinese voice, rate 1.0, pitch 1.0 and volume 1.0 selected; after clicking read the status shows "Reading… character N" and updates the character progress in real time via onboundary; when finished it shows "Reading complete". The speech is synthesized locally by the browser's built-in engine and requires no network connection.
map.语音合成需要联网吗？: Does speech synthesis require a network connection?
map.不需要。本工具调用浏览器内置的 Web Speech API（speechSyn: No. This tool calls the browser's built-in Web Speech API (speechSynthesis) to synthesize speech locally, and the text is not uploaded to the server; the list of available voices differs across browsers and systems, depending on the language packs installed on the machine.
map.为什么听不到声音？: Why can I not hear any sound?
map.部分浏览器需在用户手动点击“朗读”后才会发声（如 iOS Safari 的安全策: Some browsers only produce sound after the user manually clicks "read" (such as the security policy of iOS Safari); if the page reports "the current browser does not support the Web Speech API", please switch to the latest Chrome / Edge / Safari.
map.浏览器本地语音合成（TTS）预览与试听，支持多语音与语速调节，数据不上传。: Browser-local text-to-speech (TTS) preview and audition, supporting multiple voices and rate adjustment, with no data uploaded.
